evidence.vm: Parallels Windows 11 ARM64; x86-64 platform under Windows emulation

procedure: Compile the minimal ChartOfCharacteristicTypes definition into an XML 2.20 source tree with public Unica main.

Import and apply the source in a new isolated file infobase with pinned ibcmd 8.3.27.2214, save a CF, export only the ChartOfCharacteristicTypes object, and extract its exact UUID storage element as raw-deflate.
Load the first CF into a second isolated file infobase, save a second CF, repeat the selected XML export and exact raw extraction.
Compare both packed payloads, unpacked payloads, and selected native XML outputs byte-for-byte.

proven_claims: Pinned 8.3.27.2214 accepted and applied the unmodified Unica-generated XML 2.20 seed in an isolated file infobase.
The exact packed and unpacked object payload and selected native XML were byte-identical across two independent platform rounds.
The owner uses discriminator 34, 59 fields, header slot 13, and a complete 12-UUID generated type/value vector.
All six generated types, their identities, categories, and native XML order are exact.
All nine standard attributes use the 25-property bag with TypeReductionMode=TransformValues.
Raw owner slot 51 value 1 maps to native XML DataLockControlMode=Automatic for this exact platform and object shape.
The production decoder reproduces the complete selected native XML file byte-for-byte.
non_claims: Unica is not treated as an authority; it supplied only the initial source hypothesis.
No behavior for platform 8.3.27 builds other than 8.3.27.2214 is inferred.
No legacy 24-property CCT standard-attribute bag is accepted or claimed compatible.
No alternative raw DataLockControlMode encoding is inferred.
No non-empty CCT child Attribute, TabularSection, Form, Template, Command, or Characteristics collection is inferred.
The complete CF files and dependency objects are not committed.
The fixture is diagnostic-only and is never read as a production fallback.
